license_body:
The Story Publisher Adv (SPadv) sofwet i gat kopirait wantaim © 2022, Tyndale Bible Translators and Robin Rempel. Ol i kisim na wokim antap long as bilong en, Story Producer (version 3.0.6) jointly copyrighted © 2020, SIL International and Cedarville University. 

 Em i kamap aninit long dispela laisens: Ol i givim tok orait, nating, long olgeta manmeri husat i kisim kopi bilong dispela sofwet na ol fail bilong ol pepa i stap wantaim (dispela "Software"), long yusim na tilim gen sofwet, long wokim na tilim ol vidio long ol teks na odio-visual data, sapos ol i papa bilong dispela data o ol i gat tok orait long tilim. 

 Software i gat proteksen aninit long ol intanesenel kopirait triti provisen. Nogat wanpela man i ken rausim wanpela 'copyright' o narapela 'proprietary notice' long dispela sofwet o senisim, 'decompile', o 'disassemble' bilong sofwet. 

 Ol i givim dispela sofwet "olsem em i stap", na i no gat wanpela kain waranti, i stap klia o i no klia, na i gat ol waranti bilong salim, inap long mekim wanpela wok na noken brukim lo. Long olgeta taim ol man i raitim dispela buk o ol man i gat kopirait bai i no inap kisim asua long wanpela kleim, bagarap o narapela asua, maski em i wanpela eksen o kontrak, asua o narapela samting, we i kamap long, aut long o long koneksen wantaim sofwet o yusim o ol narapela wok insait long sofwet. 

 Ol i save bungim ol data taim yusa i salim ol infomesen bilong rejistresen. Olgeta infomesen we yusa i taipim long ol rejistresen fil, na tu kain fon, em i kisim na yusim long rimot konsalten long helpim na toktok wantaim yusa.
